messages:
alex: quick async standup — gateway/routing/auth/rate limits
alex: yesterday: finished the routing policy refactor for header-based routing, added tests for fallback path
alex: blockers: seeing intermittent 429s on long-polling lanes in staging, not confident about current token-bucket defaults
alex: today: iterate on token-bucket tweak, smoke canary, pair with priya if needed
priya: nice — i dug into the 429s this morning. looks like bursts from the mobile integration spike the per-route bucket.
priya: repro steps: hit /v1/stream with 1k concurrent short-lived conns, see bursts. log snippet: ```WARN rate_limiter.go:72 allow=false route=mobile-stream tokens=0```
priya: suggestion: lower refill_interval to 50ms for mobile-stream route and add a small queue depth override. will open a tiny PR.
sam: I can help review the PR. also, if we enable `prefix_kv_cache` on that route it might reduce token consumption for repeated session prefixes
san: typo — meant sam: also, maybe we should add a short-lived circuit breaker to avoid cascading 429s into downstream workers
jen: heads-up — staging canary currently at 10% traffic for gw-canary-2. deploy-bot reported a degraded increase in 429s ~10:12 UTC.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy initiated: gw-canary-2 ver=1.3.2 nodes=4 strategy=canary pct=10
deploy-bot: Metric alert: 429 rate up 4.8x vs baseline on route=mobile-stream (window=5m)
alex: ok pausing the canary for now — jen can you hold further rollouts until we validate priya's token-bucket tweak?
jen: holding rollouts. will flip off canary traffic in 2 min. :lock:
priya: opening PR now: #4821 — small change to route config plus unit test. cc @sam for review.
priya: config diff (excerpt): ```route "mobile-stream" { token_bucket { capacity=50 refill=5 refill_interval=50ms } queue_depth=20 }```
sam: review shortly. if tests pass, we can apply to staging and run a focused smoke (10 concurrent long-poll streams for 5m)
mike: taking ownership of the smoke harness run. will run it and post results in this thread. planning to start at :30 UTC
alex: thanks all. blocker for me is verifying the cache interactions post-change — i'll run integration against the kv cache locally after priya's PR lands
jen: FYI, filing a short ops note so oncall knows we paused canary and why. pinging #incidents if it trends.
priya: small ask — if anyone notices client auth errors after tweak, ping me. i validated locally but want eyes on staging logs
sam: LGTM in principle. will do review in next 15m.
mike: smoke run started 6212352000 (pid=smoke-77). will report pass/fail with 5-min windows.
deploy-bot: Smoke run results: 5m windows: 0 failures in 3 runs, avg 429 rate ~baseline.
alex: great — once sam merges, i'll trigger a controlled canary re-roll at 5% and we'll monitor for 15m
jen: noted. scheduling the re-roll and alerting relevant pagers. :thumbsup:
priya: thx all. short retro after lunch if we need different defaults for mobile-heavy routes
alex: end of thread — quick sync later if anything pops up.
